name: fintra-people
description: Foundry People — HR API and the employer and employee web apps.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n hr-api,employer,employee -c red,cyan,magenta "npm run dev:hr-api" "npm run dev:hr-employer" "npm run dev:hr-employee"
scripts.dev:hr-api: bash -c 'cd packages/hr-api && { [ -d .venv ] && . .venv/bin/activate; } ; set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; ENV=${ENV:-development} uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000'
scripts.build: npm --prefix packages/hr-web-employer run build && npm --prefix packages/hr-web-employee run build
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix packages/hr-web-employer install && npm --prefix packages/hr-web-employee install && echo '\nJS deps installed. For the API: cd packages/hr-api && python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt && pip install -e ../shared-py'
